items.title: What Amazon.com (AMZN)'s UK Car Marketplace Launch Means For Shareholders
items.summary: Amazon.com is expanding its Amazon Autos online car marketplace to the UK in early 2027, while Amazon Web Services continues to post revenue growth and remains a major contributor to group operating income.
